headline: Bank of Korea Releases Preliminary October 2026 Producer Price Index
summary: The Bank of Korea published preliminary Producer Price Index figures for October 2026, updating wholesale price indicators across South Korea.
why: The Bank of Korea sets monetary policy for Asia's fourth-largest economy. Producer price trends serve as a leading gauge for future consumer inflation and interest-rate trajectories.

impacts.name: KOSPI
impacts.why: South Korean producer price metrics influence domestic inflation expectations and equity valuations.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
